dataset.name: A1 Rruga e Kombit toll (Milot–Morinë)
dataset.method: The Milot–Morinë motorway concession contract (clauses 11.4.3 and 11.4.4), as ATRAKO, the state concessions agency, publishes it: EUR 5 with VAT per passage times the class's coefficient, class 4 (G: three axles, or commercial vehicles over 2.70 m) EUR 16.25, class 5 (H: four axles or more) EUR 22.5; trucks over 3.5 t with two or three axles are taken to be over 2.70 m. Excluding 20% VAT. Charged at the toll plaza by the Thirrë tunnel, either way. The page gives no date: valid_from is the day it was first read.
